summary: First iteration MVP testing of BonusRadar (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASSED including /api/bonuses, /api/bonus/{id}, /api/match, /api/calendar, /api/ai/suggest (LLM gpt-5.4 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY), /api/simulate. Frontend: 7-step onboarding wizard, home with eligible bonus cards + AI suggest, calendar, simulazione and profilo tabs, bonus detail navigation all work end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844).

ui_bugs.issue: Assegno Unico deadline 2026-02-28 is displayed with a 'Scaduta' (expired) badge in Jan 2026. The 'days remaining' logic appears to treat this future date as already passed. Verify current date computation / timezone handling.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional: Investigate 'Scaduta' logic in calendario.tsx for 2026-02-28 deadline (current date offset or timezone off-by-one).
Optional: Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in components using it (React Native deprecation warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separated (~400 lines), env vars used correctly, /api prefix respected, MongoDB not misused (no _id leaks), AI endpoints have graceful rule-based fallback as claimed.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly and all interactive elements have testID attributes.
Rule-based fallback in /api/simulate correctly returns integer estimated_annual_gain even without LLM.
